# Metric Finance

> Metric Finance explains your stocks like you're 5, for free. Pick up to 5 US stocks and get one short brief posted every trading day at 5 PM ET, right after the market closes, explaining why each one moved, in simple words with zero jargon.

Metric Finance is for everyday investors, especially young professionals, who own or follow US stocks but find financial news and analyst reports hard to read. It is not a trading platform and never gives buy or sell recommendations.

## What each daily brief covers

- Follow up questions: below each brief, readers can ask questions about their own stocks. Answers use only that brief's data and never give buy or sell advice.
- Price action: what each of your stocks did today and the simplest explanation of why it moved.
- Fundamentals: revenue, profit margins, cash and debt, translated out of accounting language.
- Peer comparison: how the company is doing against the businesses it actually competes with.
- News: only the headlines that matter to your stocks.

## Key facts

- Price: free.
- Coverage: a curated list of the most followed US stocks on the Nasdaq and New York Stock Exchange.
- Watchlist: up to 5 stocks per subscriber; change them or unsubscribe any time.
- Timing: one brief is posted on the website every trading day at 5 PM ET, covering that day's trading. Subscribers get a short email with a link when it is up, and can read every brief on their dashboard.
- Not investment advice.

## Links

- [Sign up](https://metricfinance.app/): choose your stocks and enter your email.
- [Learn: stock guides, glossary and beginner guides](https://metricfinance.app/learn): simple explainers for popular US stocks, covering what each company does, how it makes money and what moves its price.
- [Daily stock market recap](https://metricfinance.app/learn/market-today): a quick recap in simple words after every trading day.
